trackers.product_line: Branch's deep linking and attribution SDK for app developers
data_collected: device details used to identify the device, such as model, screen resolution and local IP address
taps on links and ads, app pages visited, installs, and events the developer measures
trackers.monetization_model: Branch sells deep linking and attribution to app developers. It says it doesn't rent or sell end users' data; subject to its client contracts it may use the data to improve its services, support its other products and develop new ones, and it may use de-identified or aggregated data for any purpose (its privacy policy).

data_flows.purpose: Your advertising ID and Android ID, with device details such as model, screen resolution and local IP address, to identify your device and work out which link or ad brought you to the app
data_flows.wording: According to Branch's privacy policy, last updated 2025-09-15.
